prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: eighth and final full-bleed comic illustration for the BARCODE game level-one-to-level-two transition.
Primary request: THE CACHE LINE. The exact yellow archival hatchback from image 1 is now centered low in a wide wet four-lane city road, seen from directly behind in an elevated chase camera, small enough that the broad road and towering city breathe. The composition matches the gameplay setting of image 2 but it is a new premium graphic novel painting without any HUD or numbers. Broad road rises gently toward the city horizon, dense modest lived-in warm amber shopfronts and repair garages along both sides, high plum/cyan cyberpunk skyline beyond. Sparse realistically scaled streetlamps farther apart with translucent warm beams descending to subtle wet ground pools. A few distant freight vehicles, all travelling away, no obstacles immediately against our hero. Quiet anticipation of acceleration; headlights of distant cross streets and receding red tail lights.
Input images: Image 1 is EXACT rear vehicle model; reproduce the yellow body, black/white diagonal stripes, white circular rear emblem, Greek-key edge trim, square amber/red tail lights, roof-mounted recorder box with black retention straps, two large reels visible through rear glass, dark bumper, left exhaust, yellow tow hook. Image 2 is reference for road width, curved world/horizon, bank buildings and skyline color ONLY; DO NOT include any gameplay UI, mirror, button labels, road pads, numbers or letters. Image 3 is reference ONLY for premium inked comic style and cinematic palette.
Composition/framing: panoramic 2.2:1, approximately 1860x845. Single fullbleed coherent scene no panels or gutters. Rear of yellow car centered x50%, car width about 22% of canvas and height about35%, rear tires at y83%. Horizon y39%. Wet four-lane asphalt strongest clear leading lines center. Natural wheeled ground contact, warm taillight reflections under car, no floating vehicles or unreal oversized lamps. No driver's face visible from behind. Keep important subjects away from image edge; bottom10% road texture.
Style/medium: mature hand-inked 1990s cyberpunk graphic novel, confident black contours, angular cel shadows and halftone paper grain. Warm amber lamps and yellow hero against deep plum/navy and mint-cyan light. Match third image's rich linework, no photorealism/3D/anime redesign.
Constraints: no readable text, labels, captions, dialogue, HUD, progress bars, title card, speed markings or watermark. Preserve car proportions and painted details from image1 (not a generic muscle car). City is inhabited, not apocalyptic. No race begins in this static scene; this is the launch composition before gameplay.
